title: The ergodic theory of SPDEs in a weak-noise regime
summary: Consider a parabolic SPDE \[ \partial_t u = Δu + σ(u)η, \] on $(0\,,\infty)\times\mathbb{R}^d$, where $η$ is a centered, generalized Gaussian noise with $\text{Cov}[η(t\,,x)\,,η(s\,,y)]=δ_0(t-s)Λ(x-y)$ for a tempered Borel measure $Λ$ that is positive definite and satisfies a mild weak-noise. The existence of invariant measures of versions of these types of SPDEs has been studied at great length, particularly in the ``weak-noise regime''; see for example Assing and Manthey \cite{AssingManthey2003}, Chen and Eisenberg \cite{ChenEisenberg2024}, Chen, Ouyang, Tindel, and Xia…
